name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: After Ukraine failed to shoot down a single ballistic missile fired by Russia on Wednesday, the president urged allies to increase supplies of Patriot interceptors Nato is working to get Ukraine the air defences it “urgently needs”, its secretary general has said, after Kyiv failed to shoot down a single Russian missil.

changes.title: Retired Army colonel explains why Patriot missiles are so valuable and in short supply
changes.summary: To discuss the air defense shortage in Ukraine and the impact on its ability to defend itself from Russia, Amna Nawaz spoke with retired Army Col. Robert Hamilton. He's now president of the Delphi Global Research Center, a military consulting firm.

changes.title: Alarming video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian man before exploding
changes.summary: Russia struck Ukraine with a series of missiles overnight, killing at least 17 people, according to officials. Also, shocking video appears to show a Russian drone chasing a Ukrainian vegetable vendor before exploding and wounding him. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

changes.title: Ukraine says missile interceptors may have saved lives in Russian attack
changes.summary: At least 17 people were killed after Russia hit Ukraine with a barrage of missiles, Ukrainian authorities said. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

changes.title: Finland Tries to Protect Children Against Deepfakes, With Russia in Mind
changes.summary: Finland, wary of misinformation from Moscow and beyond, has a leg up on other nations in spotting fake news. But A.I. is a whole new challenge.

changes.title: What Is 'Russia's Amazon' Wildberries and Why Is Ukraine Targeting It?
changes.summary: Smoke rises after Ukrainian strikes on a Wildberries warehouse in St. Petersburg, Russia, on July 24, 2026. —AFP—Getty Images Ukraine hit at least two warehouses belonging to Russia ’s e-commerce giant Wildberries in overnight strikes on Monday, adding to a series of drone attacks that have targeted the online retailer.

changes.title: How the Ukraine War Became a Fight for the Skies
changes.summary: Russia and Ukraine are producing ever larger numbers of innovative aerial weapons, hoping for a breakthrough as ground combat is largely frozen.

changes.title: Russia’s Deadly Missile Attack on Kyiv Exploits Ukraine’s Depleted Air Defenses
changes.summary: At least 17 people were killed, officials said, as the country runs desperately low on interceptor missiles that could fend off Russian bombardments.

changes.title: White House declassifies info on secret FBI probe into whether Trump fired Comey at Russia's behest, official says
changes.summary: The White House has declassified information claiming the FBI probed whether President Trump acted as a Russian asset when he fired James Comey, a theory an administration official said wasn't backed up by evidence.

changes.title: Ukraine hits Russia with deadly strike near busy beach, officials say
changes.summary: A Ukrainian drone struck a busy beach off the Black Sea in a deadly attack, Russian officials said, as the two countries continue to trade strikes. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has the latest.
